subject: general
question: The new capital of Andhra Pradesh is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amaravati**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Amaravati** is the newly planned capital city of the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The foundation stone for Amaravati was laid on **22 October 2015** by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
 
• The city is located on the southern banks of the Krishna River in the Guntur district.
 
• Amaravati is designed to be a modern, smart city with state-of-the-art infrastructure and sustainable development practices.
 
• The capital region development is overseen by the **Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Historical Significance**

 
 
• Amaravati has historical importance as it was an ancient city and once the capital of the Satavahana dynasty.
 
• The city is known for the Amaravati Stupa, a significant Buddhist site.
 
 
 
• **Urban Planning**
 
 
• The city is planned to be developed in line with modern urban planning principles, including smart infrastructure, efficient public transport, and eco-friendly practices.
 
• The master plan for Amaravati was prepared by the Singapore-based Surbana Jurong Private Limited.
 
 
 
• **Economic Development**
 
 
• The development of Amaravati is expected to boost economic activities in the region, creating numerous job opportunities.
 
• The city aims to attract investments in various sectors including IT, education, health, and tourism.
 
 
 
• **Governance**
 
 
• The Andhra Pradesh government has established the Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA) to oversee the development of Amaravati.
 
• APCRDA is responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and overseeing the overall development and management of the capital region.
